basic_details.job_title: KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB) has 10 Graduate Engineering Apprentice internships for B.Tech Civil Engineering or Chemical Engineering graduates. The internships are in Ernakulam, Pathanamthitta, Palakkad and Malappuram, with a stipend of 10000/- for a training period of 1 year. The Additional Skill Acquisition Programme Kerala (ASAP Kerala) is advertising the vacancies and taking applications online on its CareerLink portal until 27 October 2026.

qualification.details: The notice lists the eligibility for the Graduate Engineering Apprentices as B.Tech Civil Engineering/Chemical Engineering. It prints no passing-year window and no minimum marks.

salary_details.details: The notice calls the 10000/- stipend the "Financial Benefits". It names no other allowance. The training is an internship at Kerala State Pollution Control Board in Ernakulam, Pathanamthitta, Palakkad and Malappuram. The internship is limited to the period stated in the notification and does not guarantee a permanent position. | FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

selection_process: Candidates for the KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices internship are selected through a screening process and a rank list:

Each position will have its own screening process to judge whether candidates are suitable. The screening process may include written tests and interviews. Candidates will be evaluated on their performance
and a rank list will be published for each position.
how_to_apply: Applications are made online through ASAP Kerala's CareerLink portal and must be submitted by 27 October 2026. The notice gives these steps:
Visit the internship page https://careerlink.asapkerala.gov.in/internships/list/IN26101700187 and submit your application.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- during the registration process.
After successful registration, you will receive further instructions for the screening process.
important_instructions: The internship does not guarantee a permanent position. It is limited to the period stated in the notification. The reported vacancies, final selection and posting orders are at the sole discretion of the organisation providing the internship (Kerala State Pollution Control Board). For general enquiries, email ASAP Kerala at [email protected] or call the Head Office on 04712772500 (10.00 AM to 6.00 PM, weekdays only). ASAP Kerala is a State Public Sector Undertaking fully owned by the Government of Kerala under the Higher Education Department. Its registered office is at KINFRA Film and Video Park, Sainik School P.O, Chanthavila, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India-695585.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Kerala State Pollution Control Board has 10 Graduate Engineering Apprentice vacancies in Ernakulam, Pathanamthitta, Palakkad and Malappuram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices internship?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices internship?
faq.answer: You need a B.Tech in Civil Engineering or Chemical Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices internship?
faq.answer: The notice does not give an age limit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices?
faq.answer: The stipend is 10000/-, and the training lasts 1 year.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices internship?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/-. It is non-refundable and is paid during the registration process.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices internship?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://careerlink.asapkerala.gov.in/internships/list/IN26101700187 by 27 October 2026. Once you have registered, you will receive further instructions for the screening process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices?
faq.answer: Selection is through a screening process that may include written tests and interviews. Candidates are evaluated on their performance, and a rank list is published for each position.

faq.question: Q9. Is the KSPCB Graduate Engineering Apprentices internship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the internship does not guarantee a permanent position and is limited to the period stated, which is 1 year.
